name: fauxplane
description: Tooling for the fauxplane jet panel PWA. The deployed app is public/ and has no build step; scripts/ regenerates the navdata the app precaches and runs the accessibility gate.
//runtime-dependencies: The DEPLOYED app still has none. public/ ships exactly as written, with no bundler and no runtime package. The two devDependencies exist only for the accessibility gate and the icon renderer; nothing they touch is deployed, and automation uses npm ci against the committed lockfile (Doctrine §16.1/§16.3).
//browser: playwright-core 1.56.0 ships chromium revision 1194, matching /opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1194 in the session sandbox. These are a MATCHED PAIR — the hub learned this the expensive way: a playwright-core expecting a different revision connects and then hangs on a protocol mismatch with no error. If the sandbox browser changes, re-pin here and re-verify.
